run_pretrain_app: run the vjepa2 pretrain app with a YAML config file and specified CUDA devices
run_debug_mode: run the vjepa2 app in debug mode without spawning multiprocessing workers
load_config_yaml: load a YAML configuration file for the vjepa2 pretraining pipeline
init_distributed_training: initialize distributed training across multiple GPUs on a single machine
launch_app_with_config: launch the vjepa2 app scaffold with loaded parameters and app name
